exposure: Psychosocial stress (traumatic, financial, emotional, partner-related) three months prior to or during pregnancy
outcome: Gestational weight gain (GWG) adequacy (inadequate, adequate, excessive)
cohort: This study included 119,183 respondents from the nationally representative Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System (PRAMS) Phase 7 questionnaire 2012–2015 who delivered at or after 37 weeks gestation and had GWG information available.
finding: Among pregnant people in the US, exposure to financial stress is associated with a higher risk of excessive gestational weight gain.
